title: 第25章 音儿不能让哥哥担心！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 国破山河在，城春草木深……”“白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪……”“哈哈哈……好诗！好诗啊！哈哈哈哈……呜呜呜……”老王爷呢喃了几遍，曾经的凄凉无助感瞬间填满整个胸腔，先是为诗词大笑喝彩，紧跟着想到惨死的妻儿，便止不住落泪，呜咽哀嚎……好生的安慰了一番老王爷，将其送出城后，唐逸直接回到了唐家。回到小院，唐逸便让唐音自己玩，他回了房间开始将答应给萧策的复合弓和诸葛神弩的图纸画出来。他没有注意到，在院中追逐蝴蝶的唐音，已经追出了小院。小女孩经过几日的调养，已经朝气蓬勃，身上手上的伤也已经好得差不多了，此时宛若蝴蝶一般翩翩起舞，铃铃笑声也在风中回荡。以至于唐音都没有注意到，她已经脱离了哥哥给她标注的安全范围。“哟，是你这个小贱种呀，玩得挺高兴嘛！”一道戏谑的轻喝声在身后响起，唐音小小的身体仿佛遭到雷击一般，当场冷冷打了一个激灵。她缓缓转过身，站在不远处的，正是唐浩和林竹。以前被唐浩和林竹欺凌的记忆一股脑地涌进脑中，唐音只感觉浑身上下都疼痛起来，吓得小脸煞白。但她还是恭恭敬敬地弯腰行礼：“音儿见过二哥，二嫂，音儿不该乱跑，音儿这就回去……”唐音埋着脑袋转身离开，林竹想到这几日唐逸给她带来的耻辱，眼底一片怨毒。她笑着蹲下身，拦在唐音的前方，温和道：“怎么了？小音儿，你很害怕嫂子呀？”唐音小小的身体微微一僵，下意识地点了点头，又摇了摇头。“这孩子，嫂子以前对你严苛，那是因为爱护你呢。”林竹双手落在唐音小小的臂膀上，双手掐着她刚刚有点肉的臂膀，渐渐加重力道：“小音儿最乖了，告诉嫂子，你哥哥这几日在干嘛呢？”“还有，你们的银子是从哪里弄来的？”手臂传来剧烈的疼痛，唐音感觉自己两条手臂都快要碎了，疼得她小小的身体紧绷，小脸煞白，眼泪大颗大颗从脸上滚落。但她依旧咬着唇摇头，没有说话。哥哥说了，卖诗的事暂时是他们的秘密，不要告诉唐家其他人。她要好好地守护哥哥和自己的秘密！“小音儿，你不乖哦，是不是不想做个乖孩子了？”林竹又抓住她的大腿肉，猛地一拧。“啊！”音儿疼得惨叫出声，却又下意识双手捂住唇，不让自己哭出声音来。哥哥说了，没有哥哥的陪同，绝对不能自己跑出院子。是自己追蝴蝶不小心跑出院子的，是自己的错，不能连累哥哥。“小贱种，你嘴还挺硬。”“我让你嘴硬，我让你嘴硬，说，你说不说？”见到唐音不配合，林竹彻底被激怒，脸色怨毒而狰狞。她双手在唐音的身上乱掐乱打，却忍住没有在唐音脸上动手，足足在唐音瘦弱的身上施暴了五六分钟，直到唐音站都站不稳了才停下来。而此时的唐音，都快被折磨得不成样子了。唐浩抱着双手在一边看着，脸色戏谑而嘲讽，时不时往唐逸的院子看一眼，怕唐逸那个疯子忽然出来。“贱种，贱种，贱种……”“和你娘一样的贱种，小小年纪你清高什么？你清高什么？！”“你给我跪下，给我跪下磕头，替你哥那蠢货道歉，赔罪！”林竹歇斯底里。那天唐逸狠狠在她脸上甩了一巴掌，让她这几日整张脸肿得都没脸见人，甚至还害得他们夫妻误会，传出一些风言风语。结果他却没有受到半点惩罚。这算什么？这不公平！“小野种，你还挺有骨气。”“我倒是要看看，是你的骨头硬，还是我的脚硬！”唐浩一脚踹在唐音的背上，将唐音踹翻在地。他上来又补了两脚，唐音蜷缩在地上，小小的身体瑟瑟发抖。而她腰间的玉佩，也掉在了地上。见到玉佩，唐浩和林竹相视一眼，眼神都变得炽热而贪婪。这块玉佩单单看色泽，就是一块上好的玉佩，单论价值恐怕都得数万两银子！！！果然，唐逸的母亲，肯定给唐逸和唐音留下了一笔巨额财富！不然，他们这几日怎么可能有钱到处潇洒？“哎呀，唐浩，你看你对小音做了什么？”林竹狠狠瞪了唐浩一眼，心疼地将唐音从地上抱起来。抬手将唐音身上的灰尘都拍掉，笑吟吟道：“小音儿，这种玉佩，你和哥哥还有吗？”唐音咬着薄唇轻微摇了摇头。“没有了呀？那也没关系。”林竹将玉佩收了起来，嘴角笑容一点点变冷：“玉佩呢，嫂子先帮音儿收着了，将来音儿嫁人的时候，嫂子再给音儿做嫁妆。”“不过，音儿要记得保密哦！”“不然……”林竹的手落在唐音的大腿上，唐音吓得连连后退。“哈哈哈……”唐浩和林竹大笑，手牵着手转身离开。唐音站在原地没敢动。直到唐浩和林竹的背影消失，唐音才转身向自己的和哥哥的院子狂奔，一边跑一边抹泪……片刻。她终于跑进了小院，努力将院门关上，才蹲在地上哭了起来。哭了许久，她才从地上爬起来，努力抹掉脸上的泪水，露出了笑脸：“音音不哭，音音要坚强……”“呜呜，音音不要让哥哥担心！”可是好疼呀！唐音走到井边，努力打上来了小半桶井水，脸上的灰尘清洗干净。然后，她便进了房间。房间中，哥哥还趴在桌上忙碌，还在绘制图纸。看着哥哥的背影，唐音努力调整状态，走进房间：“哥，我能帮你吗？”“可以啊，等哥哥稳定下来，送你上学堂，你就能帮哥哥了。”唐逸笑着应了一句。随即，他将诸葛神弩和复合弓的图纸拿起来，重新检查过一遍，确定没有问题后，便将图纸折叠起来，藏到了暗格中。明日还得去一趟状元街，将图纸交给萧策或者老王爷的人。想到老王爷，唐逸又不由想起老王爷获得那首词时的样子，心头也莫名地有些触动。他提笔蘸墨，重新将这首《春望》写了下来，打算到时候再郑重送给对方。“唐逸，你大爷的，给老子滚出来，老子要弄死你！”就在这时，门外传来了怒吼声。
content_en: The country is broken, the mountains and rivers are there, the city is springy and the vegetation is deep..." "The white hair scratches are shorter, and the hairpin is full of lust..." "Hahaha... What a poem!What a poem!Hahahaha... Wuwuwu..." The old prince murmured several times, and the feeling of desolation and helplessness instantly filled his entire chest. First he laughed and applauded the poem, and then when he thought of his wife and children who died tragically, he couldn't stop crying and sobbing.Howl... After comforting the old prince and sending him out of the city, Tang Yi went directly back to the Tang family.After returning to the small courtyard, Tang Yi let Tang Yin play by himself. He returned to the room and began to give Xiao Ce the compound bow and the Zhuge Divine Crossbow.Drawing.He didn't notice that Tang Yin, who was chasing butterflies in the courtyard, had already chased her out of the courtyard.After a few days of recovery, the little girl was full of energy, and the injuries on her hands were almost healed. At this time, she was dancing like a butterfly, and her laughter was echoing in the wind.Tang Yin didn't even notice that she had left the safe zone marked by her brother."Oh, it's you, you little bitch, you are having a good time!"A joking shout sounded from behind. Tang Yin's little body seemed to have been struck by lightning, and she was coldly shocked on the spot. She turned around slowly, and standing not far away were Tang Hao and Lin Zhu. The memories of being bullied by Tang Hao and Lin Zhu in the past flooded into her mind, and Tang Yin felt pain all over her body, which scared her so much.Her face turned pale.But she still bowed and saluted respectfully: "Yin'er has seen second brother and second sister-in-law, Yin'er shouldn't run around, Yin'er should go back now..." Tang Yin buried her head and turned to leave. Lin Zhu thought of the humiliation Tang Yi had brought to her in the past few days, and there was resentment in her eyes.She smiled and knelt down in front of Tang Yin, and said gently: "What's wrong?Xiaoyin'er, are you afraid of your sister-in-law?"Tang Yin's little body froze slightly, and she nodded subconsciously, then shook her head. "This kid, my sister-in-law was harsh on you before, it was because she loved and protected you.Lin Zhu put his hands on Tang Yin's small arms, pinched her slightly fleshy arms with both hands, and gradually increased the pressure: "Xiao Yin'er is the best, tell my sister-in-law, what has your brother been doing these days?""Also, where did you get your money?""Severe pain came from her arms. Tang Yin felt that both of her arms were about to break. The pain made her little body tense, her face turned pale, and tears rolled down her face. But she still bit her lip and shook her head without saying anything. Her brother said that selling poems is their secret for the time being, and do not tell the rest of the Tang family. She must protect her brother's and her own secrets! "Xiao Yin'er, you are not good, do you not want to be a good child?Lin Zhu grabbed her thigh meat again and twisted it violently. "Ah!""Yin'er screamed in pain, but subconsciously covered her lips with her hands to prevent herself from crying. Her brother said that she must not run out of the yard without her company. She accidentally ran out of the yard chasing butterflies. It was her own fault. She can't implicate her brother. "You little bitch, you have a tough mouth."I asked you to be tough. I asked you to be tough. Say it. Will you say it?"" Seeing that Tang Yin did not cooperate, Lin Zhu was completely irritated, with a hateful and ferocious look on her face. She pinched and beat Tang Yin's body with her hands, but she restrained herself from touching Tang Yin's face. She tortured Tang Yin's thin body for five or six minutes, and did not stop until Tang Yin could no longer stand still. At this time, Tang YinHe was almost tortured to the point of death.Tang Hao was watching with his hands folded, his face was playful and mocking, and he glanced at Tang Yi's yard from time to time, fearing that the lunatic Tang Yi would suddenly come out."Bitch, bitch, bitch..." "A bitch like your mother, why are you so noble at such a young age?"What are you proud of?!"Kneel down, kowtow, apologize for that idiot of your brother, make amends!"" Lin Zhu was hysterical. Tang Yi slapped her hard on the face that day, which made her face swollen to the point where she couldn't see anyone in the past few days. It even caused the couple to misunderstand and spread some rumors. In the end, he was not punished at all. What is this? This is not fair! "You little bastard, you have quite a bit of backbone."I want to see if it's your bones that are harder, or my feet!""Tang Hao kicked Tang Yin on the back, knocking Tang Yin to the ground. He came up and added two more kicks. Tang Yin curled up on the ground, her little body trembling. The jade pendant around her waist also fell to the ground. Seeing the jade pendant, Tang Hao and Lin Zhu looked at each other, and their eyes became hot and greedy. This jade pendant aloneJust by looking at the color, it’s a fine jade pendant, and it’s probably worth tens of thousands of taels of silver!!Sure enough, Tang Yi’s mother must have left Tang Yi and Tang Yin a huge fortune!Otherwise, how could they be so rich these days?“Oh, Tang Hao, look what you did to Xiaoyin?Lin Zhu glared at Tang Hao fiercely, and lifted Tang Yin up from the ground distressedly. He raised his hand to brush off all the dust on Tang Yin's body, and said with a smile: "Xiao Yin'er, do you and your brother still have this kind of jade pendant?"Tang Yin bit her thin lips and shook her head slightly. "No more?"That's okay too.Lin Zhu put the jade pendant away, and the smile on his lips turned colder: "As for the jade pendant, my sister-in-law helped Yin'er put it away first. When Yin'er gets married in the future, she will make a dowry for Yin'er.""But Yin'er must remember to keep it a secret!""Otherwise..." Lin Zhu's hand fell on Tang Yin's thigh, and Tang Yin was so frightened that he backed away. "Hahaha..." Tang Hao and Lin Zhu laughed, holding hands and turned to leave. Tang Yin stood there without daring to move. It wasn't until Tang Hao and Lin Zhu's backs disappeared that Tang Yin turned around and ran towards his and his brother's yard.She ran and wiped her tears... for a while.She finally ran into the small courtyard, tried hard to close the door, and then squatted on the ground and cried.After crying for a long time, she got up from the ground, tried to wipe away the tears on her face, and showed a smile: "Yinyin, don't cry, Yinyin needs to be strong..." "Oh, Yinyin, don't let brother worry!"But it hurts so much! Tang Yin walked to the well, worked hard to bring up half a bucket of well water, and washed the dust off her face. Then, she entered the room. In the room, her brother was still busy on the table, drawing drawings. Looking at his back, Tang Yin tried to adjust his condition and walked into the room: "Brother, can I help you?"Okay. When your brother stabilizes and sends you to school, you can help him.""Tang Yi responded with a smile. Then, he picked up the drawings of the Zhuge Divine Crossbow and the Compound Bow, checked them again, and after confirming that there were no problems, he folded the drawings and hid them in a secret compartment.
title_en: Chapter 25 Yin'er can't let her brother worry!
